value.rationale: The motivating algorithm explicitly uses rank matching because it minimizes total partner distance. Quantitative variance reduction is the relevant objective; this theorem gives exact conditions under which ranking helps or hurts and proves that distance-optimal pairing can capture an arbitrarily small fraction of attainable conditional variance reduction. This is an algorithmically motivated failure boundary even in the simplest positive-mass setting, not a routine table calculation. The precise one-stage/equal-mass limits are explicit.
